title: Big stat + faces + rating
description: When the argument is adoption or scale, not features. Magenta stat = merge field / claim-checked number.
usage: Scale argument. The number is the hero; faces and stars back it up. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Transparent PNG: five 64px circular faces with a white ring, overlapping by 14px, composited into one image (Outlook can't overlap images).
Same composite with charcoal (#222731) rings, shown in dark mode via mfs-dark-img.
Transparent PNG of five #FFD100 stars (rasterised from the Figma vector). Same in both modes.

notes: To swap faces, rebuild both composites (light and dark ring) from the five portraits: 64px circles, 50px step, later faces on top.
The 64px stat keeps its size on mobile (as in the Mobile frame); the statement uses mfs-h2 per CONVENTIONS (28 → 24), while the Mobile frame keeps 28px.
The Figma label mentions a magenta stat, but the component renders it in charcoal; built in charcoal. If the number is a merge field, mark it #FF00F5 until it is claim-checked.
